title: Newton Golf Company, Inc. 8-K Filing — Entry into Material Definitive Agreement
summary: Newton Golf Company, Inc. (NWTG) filed an 8-K disclosing multiple closings under a securities purchase agreement dated March 16, 2026, involving convertible notes and common stock warrants. The company raised $1,350,000 in aggregate proceeds across four closings (March 16, April 7, and two on April 9, 2026) toward a maximum of $2,000,000 in funding.
key_points: First closing (March 16, 2026): $500,000 principal, 50,000 warrants at $1.75/share exercise price
Convertible notes: 18-month maturity, 10% annual interest (paid in kind), conversion price $1.60/share
Mandatory conversion trigger: stock closes at or above $3.00 for 10 consecutive trading days

The filing does not contain information about Federal Reserve policy, interest rates, Treasury market operations, or broader economic indicators.
